rejected_attempts.reason: Recovery fixture timed out after successful pressure/layout/input checks; excluded from acceptance.
After control-error recovery and explicit leave, old viewer had a connected peer and replacement slot was refused. SDK forced-retry flag root cause identified; excluded.
Public WSS HTTP 502 during an external game-service restart; excluded. Local/public HTTP upgrade endpoints later healthy; retry then passed eight checks.
Fresh Chromium navigation failed with ERR_CERT_VERIFIER_CHANGED before any check. HTTPS 200 verified and a fresh browser passed all six checks without bypassing certificate validation.
